gloss: trade name; business name; firm name

definitions.gloss: trade name; business name; firm name
definitions.explanation: The official name under which a business or company operates. A legal term used in commercial registration and business law.

examples.japanese: {商号|しょうごう}を{登録|とうろく}した。
{商号|しょうごう}を{変更|へんこう}するには{届|とど}け{出|で}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A formal filing is required to change the business name.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{地域|ちいき}で{同一|どういつ}の{商号|しょうごう}は{使|つか}えない{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: In some cases, the same business name cannot be used in the same area.

notes:
A legal and business term for the official name under which a company or individual conducts business. In Japanese commercial law, the {商号|しょうごう} is registered with the Legal Affairs Bureau ({法務局|ほうむきょく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商号|しょうごう}{登録|とうろく}: trade name registration
- {商号|しょうごう}{変更|へんこう}: change of business name
- {商号|しょうごう}を{使用|しよう}する: to use a trade name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社名|しゃめい}: company name — more common in everyday use
- {屋号|やごう}: shop name, house name — used for smaller businesses, traditional shops, and traditional family names
- {商標|しょうひょう}: trademark — a different concept; protects brands and logos rather than business names

REGISTER:
Formal/legal. In everyday conversation, {社名|しゃめい} or {会社名|かいしゃめい} is more natural.
